verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents an API with more than 120 actions and an official MCP server, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence describes API key scoping, per-key permissions, read-only keys, or any other least-privilege controls for agent credentials. The account security items (2FA, account lock, Registry Lock) protect the account itself and do not address scoped API credentials.
